value.finding: Hokuriku Electric final report (METI new-energy WG, 25 Jun 2014): fire at unit 2 caused by lightning — the hydraulic cylinder (head–rod gap) became part of the lightning current path because a down conductor had been routed along the cylinder in 2004 without the turbine maker's approval; the arc damaged the seal, hydraulic oil sprayed out and ignited. No casualties stated. Both 900 kW units of Kunimidake were decommissioned (廃止) because of ageing and winter-lightning trouble.

note_zh: 風場層沒有 2002 年的國見岳風力發電所（900 kW×2，2010 年起北陸電力）；只有 2027 年的新計畫「Fukui Kunimidake wind farm」（37.8 MW，東北電力，宣布階段），不是同一座，維持不對應。北陸電力 2014-06-25 最終報告（經產省新能源發電設備事故對應 WG 第 4 回資料）：起火原因是落雷時雷電流經油壓缸（2004 年譲受前未經風機廠確認把導雷線沿油壓缸布設），電弧損傷密封、操作油噴出著火；1、2 號機因老化與冬季雷故障增加已廢止。
note_en: The layer has no record of the 2002 Kunimidake plant (2 x 900 kW, Hokuriku Electric from 2010); 'Fukui Kunimidake wind farm' (37.8 MW, Tohoku Electric, 2027, announced) is a different later project, so the event stays unlinked. Hokuriku Electric's final report of 25 Jun 2014 (METI WG, 4th meeting): lightning current ran through the hydraulic cylinder (a down conductor had been routed along it in 2004 without the maker's approval), the arc damaged the seal and the sprayed hydraulic oil ignited; both units were later decommissioned because of ageing and winter-lightning trouble.

value.finding: Operator AOW's cause statement of 28 Sep 2023: both leaks were on the same turbine. 11 Sep: a Vestas Japan maintenance worker damaged the gearbox oil-sensor connection by a wrong operation during an oil-sensor inspection (lubricating oil, up to about 3 L estimated). 23 Sep: before the damaged part was repaired, Vestas Japan mis-operated its remote system and restarted the oil pump, sending oil into the gearbox and out through the same damaged point (up to about 280 L outside the nacelle; the oil on the sea was recovered with absorbent mats under Akita Coast Guard guidance). AOW ordered Vestas Japan to tighten staff training and site/turbine monitoring. No casualties are mentioned; no regulator (METI/NITE) finding was found.

value.finding: Control Yuan investigation report (23 Jul 2026, member 葉宜津) quoting the Ministry of Economic Affairs: unit 17 was running normally with no alarm, no maintenance scheduled, no lightning and no temperature alarm, so the cause was judged to be a short-circuit fault of electrical equipment inside the nacelle that spread to the whole nacelle. The Control Yuan found Taipower at fault for not noticing that unit 17 had the most faults of the 23 turbines (over twice the average) in Jan 2024–Apr 2026. Unit 17 belongs to phase 2 (8 units, commercial May 2010; phase 1 15 units, Jan 2009). No casualties are mentioned in the official statements.

note_zh: 對應風場層「Yunmai (Mailiao)」（台電雲麥，23×Vestas V80 2 MW）。監察院 2026-07-23 調查報告引經濟部回覆：事故前正常運轉、無警報、未排維修、無雷擊、無溫度警報，研判是「機艙內電氣設備短路故障造成起火」延燒整座機艙；監察院認為 17 號機 113/1–115/4 故障次數為 23 支中最高、逾平均 2 倍，台電未察有疏失。第 1 期 15 支 98 年 1 月商轉、第 2 期 8 支 99 年 5 月商轉（17 號屬第 2 期）——與風場層「16 in 2008, 7 in 2011」不符，建議核對。官方文件未提傷亡。
note_en: Maps to the layer record 'Yunmai (Mailiao)' (Taipower, 23 x Vestas V80 2 MW). The Control Yuan report of 23 Jul 2026 quotes the MOEA: normal operation, no alarms, no maintenance, no lightning, no temperature alarm, so the cause was judged a short circuit of electrical equipment in the nacelle that spread through it; the Control Yuan faulted Taipower for ignoring unit 17's fault record (highest of 23, over twice the average). Phase 1: 15 units, Jan 2009; phase 2: 8 units, May 2010 (unit 17) — this differs from the layer's '16 in 2008, 7 in 2011', worth checking. No casualties mentioned.

note_en: No official final cause as of 13 Oct 2026. The latest finding is from late March: Chosun Ilbo (28 Mar) cites the joint investigation by Korea Electrical Safety Corp. and Yeongdeok Wind Power — a month and a half on, the direct cause of the tower buckling was still unclear beyond signs of an alarm-sensor fault and a 6.4 m/s wind; Vestas took the SCADA data on 13 Feb but has given no result, citing the expired warranty. sources.quote: 28일 전기안전공사와 영덕풍력발전 등 합동 조사 결과에 따르면, 사고 발생 한 달 보름이 지나도록 타워 구조물(기둥) 붕괴 사고의 직접적인 원인은 명확히 밝혀지지 않았다. 알람 센서 고장 정황과 사고 당시 발전기 주변 풍속이 초속 6.4m인 점 외 뚜렷한 사고 원인이 될 단서는 없다고 한다.
풍력발전기 제조사인 덴마크 베스타스(Vestas) 기술진은 지난달 13일 영덕 사고 현장에서 ‘스카다(SCADA·원격 감시 제어)’ 데이터를 확보해 분석에 착수했다. 전기안전공사와 운영사 요청으로 사고 발생 12일 만이다.
영덕풍력발전 관계자는 “날개 속도가 일정 수준을 넘으면 알람 센서가 작동하고 제어해야 하는데 고장이 나면서 날개 파손 영향으로 기둥이 꺾인 것 같다”며 “센서 이상 원인과 관련해 제조업체가 보증 기한 경과 등을 이유로 협조하지 않고 있다”고 밝혔다.
김 의원실에 따르면 영덕 4호기는 고정볼트 파손으로 교체가 필요하다는 진단을 받았고, 7·8·19·23호기는 각각 블레이드에 발생한 균열에 수리가 필요하다는 진단을 받았다.
영덕풍력발전과 전기안전공사 등은 사고 이후 조사를 통해 블레이드(날개) 속도를 제어하는 알람센서에 이상이 있었다고 잠정 결론을 내렸다.

sources.quote: 至於八月八日發生的火災，能源署也還沒收到業者的火場鑑定報告。
由於其他離岸風場目前並未傳出火災或葉片斷裂等類似事故，能源署因此認為，有必要進一步釐清大彰化西北離岸風場近期事故接連發生的原因
同一風場接連發生事故的罕見狀況，已引起能源署關注，將請業者評估啟動風機全面健檢。
同一風場先前發生的另一起事故是火災，Ｇ０五風機於八月八日凌晨三時二十九分發生故障，五時起火，火勢直至六時三十分才停止。
沃旭能源今天表示，已初步釐清可能的過熱區域，目前還在與風機系統供應商西門子歌美颯調查事故原因，尚待最終調查結果。
本次事故能源署已發函要求業者提供火災事故調查及風機修復計畫，後續將檢視事故原因，提出改善意見
